verdict.rationale: Vanta documents background automation it runs itself: continuous monitoring with automated tests, automated evidence collection, a TPRM Agent that discovers and monitors vendors, an AI Agent that flags issues, and automated reminders and workflows. User-defined Custom Tests also feed into this pipeline. However, there is no evidence of a user-facing builder for configuring arbitrary autonomous automations, such as triggers, schedules, or agent tasks. Most of the autonomy is vendor-defined and supported only by marketing-level claims. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable automation or agent builder with triggers and recurring schedules, details on how background agents run unattended, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
